# Indie developer shows off a needle-in-a-haystack simulator and gets 48 million views

In August, indie developer NasNakarus published a teaser for an unusual simulator on social media. He made a game adaptation of an expression many may have heard: ""find a needle in a haystack."" [...] The digital haystack contains 5 million ""pieces,"" and the player must find one small needle in it. This kind of meditative entertainment is likely suitable not only for single-player but also for cooperative play.

Needle is a dependency injection (DI) system for Swift. Unlike other DI frameworks, such as Cleanse, Swinject, Needle encourages hierarchical DI structure and utilizes code generation to ensure compile-time safety. This allows us to develop our apps and make code changes with confidence. If it compiles, it works. In this aspect, Needle is more similar to Dagger for the JVM. [...] Using and integrating with Needle has two steps. Each of the following steps has detailed instructions and explanations in the linked documents.
1. Integrate Needle's code generator with your Swift project.
2. Write application DI code following NeedleFoundation's API.

Needle has two parts, the `NeedleFoundation` framework and the executable code generator. Both parts need to be integrated with your Swift project in order to use Needle as your DI system. [...] Needle aims to achieve the following primary goals:
1. Provide high reliability by ensuring dependency injection code is compile-time safe.
2. Ensure code generation is highly performant even when used with multi-million-line codebases.
3. Be compatible with all iOS application architectures, including RIBs, MVx etc.
